units: errors/widths: olive volume FRACTION (0.01 = 1 percentage point)
limitations: Five held-out adulterant systems only; one instrument and laboratory; laboratory binary mixtures. A favourable result here says nothing about other systems or deployment.

Intervals and thresholds come from SOURCE-only cross-fitted residuals and scores. Under a new adulterant the exchangeability assumption fails, so observed coverage is empirical and no coverage guarantee exists. Calibration residuals are slightly optimistic because the outer hyper-parameters were chosen by inner CV that also saw each calibration adulterant.
Abstention is a research-level risk cue, not a safety or regulatory decision, and not a guaranteed out-of-distribution detector.
Brand imbalance (walnut = 1 brand) is an uncontrolled confounder; brand breakdowns are descriptive.
Inductive mode only. The design was written after M3/M4 outer errors were seen (ADR-017 disclosure); no constant was tuned on a held-out adulterant.
